purpose: A reproducible packet for a native reviewer to assess the complete CJK product journey. Empty reviewer fields are intentional and must remain empty until an accountable human review occurs.

reviewerBrief: Review each locale independently; do not infer approval from another CJK locale.
Review all six capabilities listed in this packet; one completed evidence record covers the full locale rather than a single capability.
Keep IDs, placeholders, URLs, hashes, model names, enum values, and source excerpts unchanged.
Assess whether wording makes a stronger population or accuracy claim than the evidence supports.
Record findings before editing copy; do not overwrite a finding with an untracked preference.
A machine pass, test pass, or model opinion is not native review evidence.

journey.title: First run and orientation
steps: Confirm no implicit United States fallback

journey.title: Study setup and locale dimensions
check: labels explain what each choice changes

journey.title: Respondent-facing instrument and handoff
steps: Read all question wording and anchors
Open Validate with real people handoff
check: no synthetic response is framed as a human response
placeholders and skip instructions survive export

journey.title: Results and research design
check: no fictional sample size confidence interval
model output is not a quotation
user-provided text is not silently translated

journey.title: Population Frame and Model Card
steps: Read official source datasets and coverage date
Read known intersections and weighting method
check: conditional audience is not presented as official coverage without evidence
fit does not imply attitudinal accuracy

journey.title: Evidence Ledger and source provenance
steps: Inspect title, publisher, URL, date, and original language
Inspect retrieval hash and evidence timestamp
check: retrieved text is not called verified ground truth

journey.title: Evidence retrieval and geography
check: market maps to its own country
Global does not route to US
REQUIRE does not silently fall back
language preference is not described as truth or validation

journey.title: Multiple-run stability and convergence
check: fictional sample size is not used as a confidence interval
variation is not presented as human sampling error
model IDs and versions remain exact

journey.title: Segment follow-up interview
steps: Inspect evidence and assumptions influencing the answer
check: source and assumption provenance is visible

journey.title: Sample studies, saved projects, and exports
steps: Attempt an unsupported locale or planned ASEAN locale
check: legacy records do not invent locale evidence

required: document lang and direction are correct
every control has a localized accessible name
visible focus remains visible at all viewports
validation and live-region messages are localized
charts have a readable table or text alternative
CJK text does not clip or create page-level horizontal overflow
technical identifiers may wrap safely without changing content
Korean syllable clusters are not orphaned by unsafe word-breaking

findingsSchema.releaseRule: A locale remains review-pending when any blocking finding is open, reviewer evidence is absent, or any required capability is out of scope. Do not infer approval from zero automated findings.

forbiddenClaims: native-reviewed without a human reviewer record
confidence interval based on generated records
attitudinal accuracy based only on demographic/language fit
ASEAN locale support based only on market routing

completedPacketSchema.evidenceContentBinding: Every evidence record contentDigest is required and must be sha256:<64-lowercase-hex-characters> over the exact referenced evidence bytes. Intake binds the declared digest through the signed packet digest but does not fetch the evidence reference or independently verify those bytes.
completedPacketSchema.completionBinding: completionSummary must exactly match the signed artifact, and every completion evidenceReference must resolve to an evidenceRecords entry.
